description: Marketplace product listings, campaign brain routing, SkyeVault file and Git remote integration, and ecosystem portal knowledge for MetrAIyux 0S brain.

chunks.title: Marketplace Overview
chunks.heading: MetrAIyux 0S Marketplace — Every Product. One Command Hub.
chunks.text: The MetrAIyux 0S Marketplace is the unified product hub for the entire Skyes Over London / SOLEnterprises empire. URL: https://metraiyux-marketing.pages.dev/marketplace.html. It catalogs all deployed products and services — MetrAIyux 0S (the core AI OS), Skye Business Command Center (BCC), SOLEnterprises, Skye Vault (file storage), Legal Center, and White-Label deployments. The marketplace exposes live system stats, brain campaign routing, and an embedded vault upload widget. Use this surface to sell, demo, and run AI-powered campaigns across the empire.

chunks.title: MetrAIyux 0S Product Listing
chunks.heading: MetrAIyux 0S — The Core AI Operating System
chunks.text: MetrAIyux 0S is the flagship AI OS product. Live metrics: 16 brains active, 8 Cloudflare Workers deployed, 71 E2E tests passing (0 failures), D1 database, $150K+ in estimated infrastructure value. It is a sovereign AI operating system built for enterprise AI operators, SaaS platforms, and high-stakes business automation. White-label deployable. Found at: https://metraiyux-0s-full-system.graylondonskyes.workers.dev/

chunks.title: Skye Business Command Center (BCC)
chunks.heading: Skye BCC — Business Intelligence Command Center
chunks.text: Skye Business Command Center (BCC) is a dedicated business intelligence and operations dashboard for the Skyes Over London ecosystem. It provides command-room UI, brain routing, and operational control surfaces. Accessible via the ecosystem portal and marketplace. Sold as a standalone product or bundled with MetrAIyux 0S deployment.

chunks.title: SOLEnterprises
chunks.heading: SOLEnterprises — The Holding Company Surface
chunks.text: SOLEnterprises is the holding company and public face of Skyes Over London LC. Main website: https://solenterprises.org/. It covers commerce, media, logistics, AI operator services, staffing, and client services. The public legal and compliance layer lives at Legal Skyes. SOLEnterprises is the parent entity for all empire products and brands.

chunks.title: Skye Vault — File And Git Storage
chunks.heading: Skye Vault — Client File Drop and Developer Git Remote
chunks.text: Skye Vault is the empire-wide file storage, client upload, and developer repo recovery system. Live URL: https://skyevault-drop.netlify.app. Clients and customers can upload files via a drag-drop interface. Developers can use the SkyeVault Git remote lane for clone, push, fetch, protected refs/tags, quota checks, verified snapshots, bundle restore, CLI access, SSH wrapper, and per-workspace neural maps. Source-routing is supported — append ?source=<property> to tag uploads by origin (e.g., ?source=marketplace, ?source=legal, ?source=solenterprises). The vault is embeddable on any site via iframe or the vault-widget.js drop-in script. Backend uses Cloudflare R2 plus Git remote storage with signed upload and proof receipts.

chunks.title: Legal Center Product Listing
chunks.heading: Legal Center — Public Policy and Compliance Layer
chunks.text: Legal Skyes is the public legal hub for the entire Skyes Over London ecosystem. Deployed at: https://skyes-over-london-legal.pages.dev/. It covers terms of service, privacy policy, AI product terms, SMS consent, SaaS platform policy, DMCA/IP notice, and 30+ live policies. It is the compliance front door for buyers, users, carriers, developers, contractors, and clients. The legal site runs a local browser brain for public policy Q&A.

chunks.title: White-Label Deployments
chunks.heading: White-Label — Deploy the Empire Stack Under Any Brand
chunks.text: MetrAIyux 0S and the full Skye ecosystem stack are available for white-label deployment. Clients get a branded AI OS, custom command center, brain routing, legal policy layer, vault storage, and optional SkyeVault Git remote workspace infrastructure under their own domain and identity. White-label deployments include custom branding, separate Cloudflare Workers, private brain configuration, workspace vault policy, and proof surfaces. Pricing negotiated per deployment. Contact: grayskyes@solenterprises.org. Sell sheet: https://metraiyux-marketing.pages.dev/white-label.html

chunks.title: Brain Campaign Routing
chunks.heading: Brain Campaigns — Autonomous AI Marketing and Sales Operations
chunks.text: The marketplace brain campaign system routes sales, marketing, and operations tasks to the correct specialist brain. Four campaign types are available: (1) MetrAIyux 0S OS Campaign — routes to Celeste Monroe (AE) and Valentina Reyes (marketing), targets enterprise AI operators; (2) Skye BCC Campaign — routes to Donovan Pierce (government/enterprise) for command center deployments; (3) Vault Campaign — routes to Celeste Monroe for storage upsell; (4) White-Label Campaign — routes to Julian Mercer and Gray London Skyes for white-label enterprise deals. Campaigns run autonomously through the 16-brain runtime.

chunks.title: Ecosystem Portal
chunks.heading: MetrAIyux Ecosystem Portal — Empire Command Hub
chunks.text: The Ecosystem Portal links all 7+ empire properties in one cinematic command surface. URL: https://metraiyux-ecosystem-portal.pages.dev/. Properties linked: SOLEnterprises, MetrAIyux 0S, MetrAIyux Public Spectacle, MetrAIyux Marketing, Skye Business Command Center, Legal Center (Legal Skyes), and Skye Vault. The portal includes a particle field background, property cards with live links, a vault upload spotlight, and a legal policy strip. Use this as the master navigation hub for all empire surfaces.

chunks.title: Marketing Site
chunks.heading: MetrAIyux Marketing Site — Full Product Documentation
chunks.text: The MetrAIyux 0S marketing site provides full product documentation, capabilities, sell sheet, and white-label information. URL: https://metraiyux-marketing.pages.dev/. Pages: Main (index.html), Capabilities, Sell Sheet, White Label, Marketplace. The marketing site uses Orbitron, Rajdhani, and Space Grotesk fonts with a dark space aesthetic. It targets enterprise buyers, AI operators, and SaaS platform owners.

chunks.title: Vault Embed and Integration
chunks.heading: Embed Skye Vault on Any Empire Surface
chunks.text: Skye Vault can be embedded on any website three ways: (1) Direct link — https://skyevault-drop.netlify.app/?source=<property>; (2) Iframe embed — <iframe src='https://skyevault-drop.netlify.app?source=<property>&embed=1'></iframe>; (3) Drop-in widget script — <script src='https://metraiyux-ecosystem-portal.pages.dev/vault-widget.js' data-source='<property>'></script>. Source tags available: marketplace, legal, solenterprises, portal, os, bcc, marketing. The vault widget auto-injects a gold-gradient button or inline iframe based on the data-mode attribute.

chunks.title: Product Count and Scale
chunks.heading: Empire Scale — Products, Brains, Workers, Policies
chunks.text: Current empire scale at MetrAIyux 0S: 11+ deployed web surfaces, 16 active brains, 8+ Cloudflare Workers, 30+ live legal policies, white-label ready. Core properties: SOLEnterprises, MetrAIyux 0S, MetrAIyux Public Spectacle, MetrAIyux Marketing, Skye Business Command Center, Legal Skyes (Legal Center), Skye Vault, Marketplace, Ecosystem Portal, Operator Portal, Sovereign Business Command. The brain count covers all 16 cabinet brains from Gray London Skyes (founder) through specialist brains in sales (Celeste Monroe), marketing (Valentina Reyes), government (Donovan Pierce), legal (Julian Mercer), QA (Victor Saint/Marcus Vale), technical (Orion Hayes), pricing (Naomi Sterling), and security (0meg4kai).

chunks.title: Operator Portal

chunks.text: The Sovereign Business Command page is the sales/offer page for Skyes Over London's primary client service. URL: https://metraiyux-ecosystem-portal.pages.dev/sovereign. It covers three build options: (1) Command Website — public front, service pages, lead capture, proof sections; (2) Business Command System — adds private dashboards, client portals, approval inboxes, file/form workflows; (3) Sovereign Operating Layer — full AI command units, automation workers, database-backed flows, deployment ledger, founder command center. Contact: grayskyes@solenterprises.org. The page explains the 6 operating layers: Public, Portal, Command, Automation, AI, and Proof layer.
